user.title: FloorCast
user.description: FloorCast adds a floor plan editor to the sidebar and a floor plan card for dashboards. Draw the plan in the FloorCast panel after setup.

press.name: Press
press.description: Does what a tap on the plan does: switches the lights of a room, moves the blind of a window, switches a device.

room.name: Room
room.description: Id of a room on the plan; its lights switch together.

opening.name: Window or door
opening.description: Id of a window or door; its blind stops, closes or opens.

device.name: Device
device.description: Id of a device on the plan; a screen switches on or off, others toggle.
